_comment: Claude Code CLI provider — requires the claude CLI installed and authenticated. Two auth modes: (1) API key billing — keep the env block below with $ANTHROPIC_API_KEY interpolation. (2) Claude subscription (Pro/Max) logged in via `claude login` in your terminal — delete the env block entirely (set it to {}); leaving a literal/unresolved ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in env overrides the CLI's own stored OAuth session and breaks auth.
